name: foray-corpus
description: Research-corpus tooling: polite fetcher, HTML/PDF→markdown extraction, SQLite+FTS5 corpus DB and CLI. Dependencies are deliberately scoped to this directory (same pattern as backend/ and player/) — the repo root stays dependency-free. DB and all fetched bytes live in data-local/corpus/ (gitignored); nothing fetched is ever committed.

scripts.//test: This package owns its own runner flags — node:sqlite is flagged on Node 22.x (CI's version; accepted and redundant on >=23.4), so `npm test` here is the ONLY command that is correct on every machine. tools/ci/run-suites.mjs invokes it as `npm test -- <files>`, which is why no file pattern is baked in: with arguments it runs exactly the suites CI discovered, and with none it falls back to node --test's own recursive discovery from this directory.
